page.overview:
Who is Albertosaurus?

is an extinct genus of tyrannosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived in Horseshoe canyon formation between 71 and 68 million years ago in the Late Cretaceous period. Related and physically similar to its larger and more famous cousin Tyrannosaurus, albeit smaller, faster, and more slender in comparison, Albertosaurus could attain a length of 9 to 10 meters (30–33 feet) and a height of 3-3.6 meters (10–12 feet). It weighed about 3–4.4 tons. At one time, the related genus Gorgosaurus, another tyrannosaurid, was thought to be a species of Albertosaurus, but now they are usually considered two separate genera. Albertosaurus was one of top predators of its habitat as it had a big number of plant eaters to feed on, especially ceratopsians like Anchiceratops or Pachyrhinosaurus, or hadrosaurs like Saurolophus or Hypacrosaurus. There is also fossil evidence that this large, ferocious predator may have hunted in packs to bring down too large of prey such as Edmontosaurus. Albertosaurus also had a more slender skull and bones than other tyrannosaurs, making it a slim yet graceful deadly predator. Additionally, some paleontologists have speculated that Albertosaurus could run as fast as 30 mph.

Albertosaurus appeared on the website Jurassic Park Institute now available to browse on Dinopedia.

Albertosaurus made its first appearance in the video game Jurassic Park: Trespasser. It can kill Anne with a single bite.

Only 3 Albertosaurus are present in the final game; the first time it is seen is after a fall from a cliff in 'Industrial Jungle', hunting for Parasaurolophus alongside several Velociraptor. The other two Albertosaurus are located in the first 'Ascent' level. The first Albertosaurus can be killed with a machine gun mounted to a wrecked truck, and the second and third Albertosaurus can be dispatched with the toxic gun, a weapon that can bring the animal down with only a single shot.
